description: This Kotlin source file defines a fragment class `HomeFragment` for an Android TV application. It uses the Leanback library to create a browsing interface with top navigation labels, content rows with media cards, and a full-width hero/banner background. The class manages UI setup, background management, focus handling, and row construction. It also contains a data model `CardItem` and a presenter class `HeroCardPresenter` for rendering media cards.
